entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker and telepathic sorcerer; the novel is his origin story.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker and megalomaniacal leader of the Infinite Consortium.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker and necromancer who manipulates Jace, bound by a deal with demons.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who gains the consortium; Liliana hopes to enlist his aid.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Jace blackmails for a living and later hides.

events.summary: Jace joins Tezzeret's consortium and trains under him.
events.quote: then he joins the Infinite Consortium

events.summary: Jace dislikes Tezzeret's methods and runs away to hide on Ravnica.
events.quote: runs away to hide on Ravnica

events.summary: Liliana enters the story; Jace falls in love and she uses him to bring down Tezzeret.
events.quote: Liliana Vess enters the story and Jace falls in love with her.

events.summary: Jace and Tezzeret duel and Jace wipes out Tezzeret's mind, leaving the consortium to Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: the two duel, resulting in Jace wiping out Tezzeret's mind

events.summary: Jace discovers Liliana's manipulation and her demon deal, forgives her and sets out to free her.
events.quote: He decides to forgive her and sets off to find a way to free her from her pact.
